== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 7 November 2018. The Facebook photo viewer names Brian Garrison. Identification: distinctive name plus Bravo 14 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Tempe, Az). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/brian.garrison.90. The same profile commented on [[Michael Girard]]'s January 2026 photograph (Gold 120, Apache Junction / Gilbert Az).

Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot (Wayback 20261030162447 of the Route C snapshot). Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Brian Garrison portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Brian Garrison Facebook portrait.jpg]].
